set_n_cpu_devices: set the number of CPU devices XLA uses for testing jax.pmap on a single-CPU platform
fake_jit: create a context manager that patches jax.jit with the identity function to disable JIT compilation for debugging
fake_pmap: create a context manager that patches jax.pmap with jax.vmap to replace parallel transformations for debugging
fake_pmap_and_jit: create a context manager that patches both jax.pmap and jax.jit simultaneously for debugging JAX code
OnCallOfTransformedFunction: create a context manager that injects a callback into every call of a JAX-transformed function for profiling
